messages:
emma_support: Hi — customer Acme Inc (acct: acme-corp) reported auto-charge failure for invoice INV-2026-45. Error shown to customer: 'Authentication failed / SCA timeout'. They tried a retry and it still declined. Sending logs below.

olivia_payments: Thanks @emma_support. Can you paste the last4 and payment/session ids? Also whether this was a PO or normal invoice charge?

emma_support: Last4 6789, live card on file. Auto-charge (no PO). Payment intent/session: pi_1GfXb2Yz, sess_9876. Our gateway log shows decline_code: authentication_timeout and acquirer_response: 3DS_TIMEOUT.

ryan_engineer: I pulled the webhook/events -> we got `payment_failed` then a `payment_intent.canceled` after ~25s. Raw acquirer status: `3DS_CHALLENGE_TIMEOUT`. I pasted the raw snippet: 
```
{
  "id":"pi_1GfXb2Yz",
  "status":"requires_action",
  "last_payment_error":{
    "message":"Authentication timed out",
    "decline_code":"authentication_timeout"
  },
  "acquirer":{
    "id":"acq_78eu",
    "response":"3DS_CHALLENGE_TIMEOUT"
  }
}
```

noah_ops: Is this reproducible? Any browser or network traces from the customer? Timing matters—if acquirer or issuer closes the challenge early we'll see this.

emma_support: Customer repro steps: desktop Chrome, auto-charge triggered at 2026-05-12T07:02:15Z, 3DS modal popped, then blank/timeout at ~25s and customer got returned to merchant with error. Merchant redirect: https://acme-app.example.com/3ds-return. They captured a screenshot showing the 3DS iframe stuck and then the merchant page showing "Payment failed".

ryan_engineer: Quick notes: our default SCA challenge window is 30s client-side; some issuers will time out faster. Two short-term mitigations: (1) allow a single automatic retry of the auth after ~30–60s (server-side) falling back to a different acquirer route; (2) change messaging so merchant sees "SCA timed out — ask customer to retry via checkout link" rather than generic decline.

stripe-bot: webhook: event=payment_intent.requires_action id=pi_1GfXb2Yz -> final_status=canceled (25s) decline_code=authentication_timeout acquirer_id=acq_78eu

olivia_payments: I'll open a support case with the acquirer (CardNet) — include acq_id + session + screenshots. @ryan_engineer please include routing logs. I'll request acquirer to confirm their 3DS challenge TTL and whether they saw an issuer timeout.

noah_ops: I'll audit our routing for acme-corp to see if they hit a single acquirer pool or had fallback enabled. If we confirm acquirer-side timeouts we can flip fallback on for this merchant. ETA ~2 hours.

emma_support: Sending the customer a manual pay link + ask for a screenshot of browser devtools network waterfall. Also asked them to try an alternate card if available.

ryan_engineer: Created internal follow-up RD-8427: "auth_timeout spikes for auto-invoices — add one retry, add 24h alert if rate >0.5%". Assigning to payments team. :thumbsup:

olivia_payments: Copy — I'll attach acquirer ticket #CN-23214 once opened and update thread. Thanks everyone.
